page: Microsoft Azure E48ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at up to 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates 48 dedicated vCPUs spanning 24 physical cores with two threads per core. The processor features 260 MB of L3 cache alongside specialized instruction support including AVX-512, AMX Tile, and AMX INT8 for matrix operations, cryptography acceleration via VAES and SHA-NI, and Intel virtualization extensions.

Hardware capacity includes 384.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB per-vCPU ratio suited for large in-memory working sets. High-speed local ephemeral storage is bundled with the instance, providing 2832 GB of NVMe SSD capacity alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. The system operates without discrete graphics hardware, containing zero GPUs and directing all compute throughput to the CPU cores.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong general and specialized processing performance across diverse compute tasks. In Geekbench testing, the server achieves strong ratings with scores of 1,979.0 in single-core and 18,086.0 in multi-core metrics, supplemented by top-tier image processing results of 19,707.0. PassMark evaluation shows an overall CPU score of 62,531.31, driven by high scores in extended instructions and hardware-accelerated encryption. Memory bandwidth tests reveal cached small-block read speeds reaching 3,669.37 GB/sec, whereas uncached large-block reads measure 150.43 GB/sec and writes measure 69.83 GB/sec.

In operational benchmark profiles, the instance delivers high throughput in data-intensive and network-adjacent scenarios. Redis SET operations reach 65.36 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput measures 79.95 GB/sec. CPU-driven inference benchmarks demonstrate high-throughput capabilities for small to medium language models using its onboard AMX and vector extensions, generating 330.01 tokens per second on small 135M models and 30.03 tokens per second on 7B models. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression yields 298.92 GB/sec.

Given its high memory allocation per core, generous NVMe SSD scratch space, and balanced compute capabilities, Microsoft Azure E48ds_v6 is positioned for production database workloads, large in-memory caching systems, big data processing pipelines, and enterprise enterprise-grade web serving infrastructure.
